payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage 'dreaming' with the magazine as primary and the Wedded Advisor as secondary, matching services.md for early-stage readers. Both /magazine and /wonderland-concierge exist in link-map.csv. Panel likelihood to enquire is 2.1, driven by deferred business details (fee model, named Advisor, scale, privacy) that cannot be answered in copy without new facts, so the CTAs stay low-pressure: a free read now and the Advisor invitation at the close. The panel's 'what next after paperwork' worry is already answered in the paragraph directly above the primary marker (registry and parish), so no copy is needed before the CTA. The subtexts reuse brand-facts wording (fee agreed in writing) and add no prices, business claims, paperwork help or travel to Ukraine. 08-final.md is about 3,387 words including markup, above the 3,000 cap, so added copy is limited to the CTA block text and one UTM change.
